body:
## Why

A profile says how to *start* a session and nothing about what to reach for inside it. `DEFAULT_PROFILES`
(`src/board.js`) carries `mode`, `launch`, `allowed_tools`, `model`, `effort`, `heartbeat`, `track_agents` —
every one about spawning. Nothing maps a *kind of work* to *what this harness does for that kind of work*.

The one half-attempt is broken: `kb.skills` renders into the brief (`src/context.js`) while `Skill` was absent
from the allowlist, so the field told a worker to do something `dontAsk` guaranteed to refuse (#114).

## What

- **`"capabilities"` on a profile** — an object mapping an intent to this harness's command. Schema and
  validation in `src/board.js`; an unknown intent fails `loadBoard` naming the vocabulary.
- **`CAPABILITIES` exported from `src/model.js`**, pinned by a test the way `EVENT_KINDS` and `GROOM_KINDS` are,
  so an intent cannot be added without saying what it means. Start small — `review`, `goal`, `specify` — and
  make adding one a deliberate act.
- **Absent means today's behaviour**, everywhere. A board with no `capabilities` key is unchanged.
- Do not render the brief (a sibling's) or derive the grant (another sibling's, through #255).

## Done when

- [ ] A profile accepts `"capabilities"`; an unknown intent fails `loadBoard` naming the vocabulary.
- [ ] `CAPABILITIES` is exported and pinned by a test that fails when an intent is added without documenting it.
- [ ] A board with no `capabilities` key behaves byte-identically to today, pinned by a test.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Contract

Names a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives.

- **`effectiveTools(profile, task, board)` (#255) is the only place a launch's tool list is derived.** A grant
  implied by a capability binding goes through it. Never read `profile.allowed_tools` directly.
- The profile key is `"capabilities"`, an object mapping an intent to this harness's command:
  `"capabilities": { "review": "/code-review", "goal": "/goal" }`.
- `CAPABILITIES` is the closed vocabulary, exported from `src/model.js` and pinned by a test the way
  `EVENT_KINDS` and `GROOM_KINDS` are — a new intent cannot be added without saying what it means.
- **An unmapped intent is not an error.** It falls back to today's prose brief. That is what keeps a Copilot or
  Codex board working unchanged, and it is the whole difference between a capability map and a dependency.
- Portability is the constraint the design exists to satisfy: the *intent* travels, the *binding* is local. hkb
  must never name `/code-review` itself outside a board's own config.
- Read `hkb show 217` for the goal, and #114 for the instance this generalises.
goal: A profile accepts a capabilities map with an unknown intent failing loadBoard; CAPABILITIES is exported from model.js and pinned by a test; a board with no capabilities key is byte-identically today's behaviour
title: A profile declares a capability map: an intent from a closed vocabulary, bound to what this harness calls it
